description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the ProductService interface, specifically for handling product-related business logic within an e-commerce system (likely Shopizer). It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving products, managing associated entities such as descriptions, attributes, images, availabilities, and relationships, and integrating with search indexing.

classes.name: ProductServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ProductService managing product CRUD, relations, descriptions, images, and search indexing.

methods.name: addProductDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a product and updates the search index.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products filtered by category IDs, optionally considering language.

methods.name: getProductDescription
methods.description: Fetches the product description for a given product and language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its search engine friendly URL within a store.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Fetches product data tailored for a specific locale and language, including availability and language settings.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of products associated with a merchant store according to criteria.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Returns products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its code and language.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product, including related images, relationships, and search index removal.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new product and indexes it in search.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists new or existing product data—handling descriptions, availabilities, attributes, relationships, images, and updating the search index.
